integration: Per-model/per-attention attributes; projection PDL enabled for every variant.
method: One shared G32 model, short scales and qualified projection PDL, BF16 prefill, FP32 codec, context/head buckets. Control uses ordinary QK/attention/reduction. Late candidate hints after QK wait, after attention logits, after reduction wait. Preload candidate reads immutable Q/K norm weights before waiting, hints after QK normalization, after attention/reduction waits. Separate graph sets, eager dispatch restored. Rotating/reversed order; one excluded warmup triplet. Cached cloned voice and all 32 codebooks; complete float32 PCM, no registration/network.
